  - Reading | The Photon Model
  

Definitions:
- Ionizing radiation: EM radiation that has enough energy to knock electrons out of the atoms and molecules of the matter it interacts with.
- Photon: a particle of EM radiation. The energy of each particle depends on the frequency of the radiation.
- Photovoltaic material: a material that converts EM radiation of visible light or higher frequency to electrical energy in moving electrons, like a solar cell.
